name: Royal Historian Archesonus
summary: At the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus records calamities for the Ironforge crown. A dwarven scholar in King Magni Bronzebeard’s service, she writes of disasters in the northern human kingdoms and oversees study of ancient dwarven tragedies, including the Dark Iron kingdom’s scorched remains.

sections.title: Chronicler of Catastrophe
sections.body: Royal Historian Archesonus keeps Ironforge’s records near King Magni Bronzebeard’s throne in the High Seat. Her studies reach beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She wrote 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' and 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights.' In them, she traces the Scourge’s ruin of humanity’s northern realm. She records the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse with care.

sections.title: The Ashes of Thaurissan
sections.body: Royal Historian Archesonus oversees research into the War of the Three Hammers and Thaurissan’s destruction. She seeks relics and charred tablets from the Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes, and sends adventurers there to search. Her work examines the cataclysm that scorched the Burning Steppes and bound the Dark Iron clan to the Firelord.

faq.q: Where can I find Royal Historian Archesonus?
faq.answer: Find Royal Historian Archesonus in the High Seat of Ironforge, near King Magni Bronzebeard’s throne room.

faq.q: What books did Royal Historian Archesonus write?
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus wrote 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' and 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights.' Her books record the downfall of the human north and the necrotic afflictions spread by the Scourge.

faq.q: Why is Archesonus interested in the Ruins of Thaurissan?
aliases: why does she want ruins of thaurissan
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus studies ancient dwarven history and sends scouts into the Burning Steppes to recover lost relics from the Ruins of Thaurissan. She seeks to piece together the catastrophe that destroyed the ancient Dark Iron capital.

faq.q: What is her role in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus is Ironforge’s official Royal Historian, chief chronicler, and archivist for King Magni Bronzebeard. She compiles records of dwarven antiquity and wider events threatening the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you share a people whose painful lessons from the War of the Three Hammers remain in Ironforge’s records. Those records are meant to keep the Bronzebeard clan from repeating the Dark Irons’ hubris.

As an Alliance member, you can read Archesonus’s grim account of Lordaeron’s fall. Her works preserve it for southern allies, so they understand the plague and the forces that broke humanity’s northern kingdoms.
